title: Weekly 1:1 with Priya
notes:
- brightline closed! 42 seats annual
- SSO guide unblocked it -> add to all sec reviews
- acme: CFO will push on price, ~120 seats
- priya owns northwind e2e, me on pricing only
- feedback: demo too long -> 20 min
- ok'd 15% startup discount yr1

segments.speaker: you
segments.label: You
segments.text: How are you doing? Last week sounded rough with the quarter-end push.

segments.speaker: them
segments.label: Priya
segments.text: Better, honestly. I closed Brightline on Thursday, so the pressure's off a bit. Forty-two seats, annual.

segments.speaker: you
segments.label: You
segments.text: That's great, congrats. What made it land in the end?

segments.speaker: them
segments.label: Priya
segments.text: Their CTO wanted SSO before signing. Once security sent over the Okta setup guide, it moved in two days.

segments.speaker: you
segments.label: You
segments.text: Good to know. Let's make that guide part of every security review. What's on your plate this week?

segments.speaker: them
segments.label: Priya
segments.text: Mostly Acme. Dana warned me their CFO will push on price at the renewal. They're growing to about a hundred and twenty seats.

segments.speaker: you
segments.label: You
segments.text: I'm taking the renewal call with Dana next week. I'll bring two pricing options, including a two-year term.

segments.speaker: them
segments.label: Priya
segments.text: That'll help. I'd break out viewer seats too. A lot of their managers only look at dashboards.

segments.speaker: you
segments.label: You
segments.text: On your growth plan: you said you wanted to run a full deal cycle on your own. How do you feel about that?

segments.speaker: them
segments.label: Priya
segments.text: I'd like to own the Northwind expansion end to end. I'll probably still want you on the pricing call.

segments.speaker: you
segments.label: You
segments.text: Deal. You own Northwind, and I'll only join for pricing. One piece of feedback: your demo runs long. Try to get it to twenty minutes.

segments.speaker: them
segments.label: Priya
segments.text: Fair. I'll trim the analytics section and send you the new version by Friday.

segments.speaker: you
segments.label: You
segments.text: Anything you need from me?

segments.speaker: them
segments.label: Priya
segments.text: Approval to offer the startup discount on Northwind if they ask. Fifteen percent, first year only.

segments.speaker: you
segments.label: You
segments.text: Approved, fifteen percent for year one. Let's check in on it next week.
